prerequisite: Run once before building TINs, offsetting with offset_cone_contours, computing areas or hatching; self-intersecting lines make those operations fail or quietly give wrong numbers
fixture_requirements: A closed boundary with a small loop (bow-tie shape, loop area far smaller than the body) -- verifies dropping the small loop and keeping the large one
An open line with a lasso loop -- verifies open lines always drop the loop and keep the trunk
A figure-8 (two lobes of similar area) -- verifies max_drop_ratio blocks it, it goes to needs_manual and the drawing is unchanged
A line with arc segments where an arc takes part in the self-intersection -- verifies the CurveCurveIntersector2d path and bulge splitting
A line with adjacent coincident vertices -- verifies deduplication does not produce false positives
A line that is already clean -- verifies it is untouched and not counted in self_intersecting
assertions: In-memory change only: results must be kept with an explicit save_dwg
At least one of handles and layer must be given, otherwise throw; a layer with no polylines throws and names the layer
with report_only=true no line is changed; only the intersection coordinates are reported (usable for drawing markers)
repaired lines no longer self-intersect: Detect returns empty (per_polyline.clean == true)
closed lines keep the ring with the larger area: repaired area == original area - the dropped loop areas (with arc-segment circular-segment correction)
open lines keep the trunk: loops are always dropped, repaired length < original length
when the dropped loops exceed max_drop_ratio x original area/length the line goes to needs_manual and is not touched at all (original entity and handle remain)
repair is a replacement: the old line is Erased and a new one added; layer/colour/linetype/elevation/normal are kept via SetPropertiesFrom
adjacent coincident vertices are removed first (duplicate_vertices_removed reports the count) so zero-length segments do not cause false self-intersections
snap-closed lines (Closed=false but first and last points coincide) are treated as closed and the closing segment takes part in detection
already-clean lines do not enter per_polyline and are not counted in repaired
Idempotent: running again after a repair gives self_intersecting == 0 and repaired == 0
Results match the products\waterbox command C3DF-FixSelfIntersect(ZJ) on the same drawing and parameters (same SelfIntersectionCore)
